questions.query: How is console markup like [bold red] parsed into styled text?
questions.reference: rich/markup.py: render() parses markup tags with the RE_TAGS regex (via _parse) and builds a Text with styled spans; escape() escapes brackets.

questions.query: Where is a style string such as 'bold red on white' parsed?
questions.reference: Style.parse in rich/style.py parses a style definition into a Style: attribute words, a foreground color, and a background color after 'on'.

questions.query: How are colors downgraded for terminals that support only 256 or 16 colors?
questions.reference: Color.downgrade in rich/color.py converts a color to a ColorSystem: truecolor to the nearest EIGHT_BIT (256) or STANDARD (16) palette color.

questions.query: How does Text wrap long lines to a given width?
questions.reference: Text.wrap in rich/text.py splits the text into lines, gets break offsets from divide_line in rich/_wrap.py, divides the text at them and applies justify and overflow.

questions.query: Where is the width of a string in terminal cells computed, including wide characters?
questions.reference: cell_len in rich/cells.py returns the cell width of a string, with a fast path for single-cell text and get_character_cell_size for wide characters.

questions.query: How are table column widths calculated to fit the console?
questions.reference: Table._calculate_column_widths in rich/table.py measures each column with _measure_column, then expands or collapses widths (ratios, min/max) to fit the available width.

questions.query: How is the speed of a progress task estimated?
questions.reference: Task.speed in rich/progress.py divides the completed amount in the recent ProgressSample entries (_progress) by the time they span; Task.time_remaining uses that speed.

questions.query: How does Live refresh the display in the background?
questions.reference: _RefreshThread in rich/live.py is a thread started by Live.start that calls refresh() refresh_per_second times per second until stopped.

questions.query: Where is source code highlighted with Pygments?
questions.reference: Syntax.highlight in rich/syntax.py runs the Pygments lexer and turns the tokens into a styled Text using the SyntaxTheme.

questions.query: How is a traceback extracted from an exception, including local variables?
questions.reference: Traceback.extract in rich/traceback.py walks the exception and its chained causes into Stack and Frame objects, capturing locals when show_locals is set.

questions.query: How does pretty printing decide to split a container over several lines?
questions.reference: rich/pretty.py builds a Node tree with traverse(); the lines are expanded with _Line.expand when check_length says they do not fit max_width, or when expand_all is set.

questions.query: Where are log records rendered by Rich's logging handler?
questions.reference: RichHandler.emit in rich/logging.py formats the record, builds a Traceback when exc_info is present, and calls RichHandler.render to lay out time, level, message and path.

questions.query: How is console output exported as an SVG image?
questions.reference: Console.export_svg in rich/console.py renders the recorded output as an SVG of a terminal window; Console.save_svg writes it to a file.

questions.query: Where does a prompt check the user's answer against a list of choices?
questions.reference: PromptBase.check_choice in rich/prompt.py compares the answer with choices (optionally case-insensitive); process_response raises InvalidResponse when it is not one of them.

questions.query: How are Markdown documents rendered in the terminal?
questions.reference: The Markdown class in rich/markdown.py parses with markdown-it (MarkdownIt) and renders the tokens through MarkdownElement subclasses such as Heading, CodeBlock, ListElement and TableElement.

questions.query: Where are the characters for panel and table borders defined?
questions.reference: rich/box.py defines the Box class and box styles such as ROUNDED, HEAVY and ASCII.

questions.query: How is a tree with guide lines rendered?
questions.reference: The Tree class in rich/tree.py renders nested labels with the guide characters in TREE_GUIDES, styled by guide_style.

questions.query: What calls the markup parser when a string with markup is printed?
questions.reference: Console.render_str in rich/console.py calls render_markup (rich.markup.render) when markup is enabled; Text.from_markup in rich/text.py also calls it.

questions.query: What cuts rendered segments into lines of the console width?
questions.reference: Console.render_lines in rich/console.py calls Segment.split_and_crop_lines (defined in rich/segment.py); Console.print and the export code call it too.

questions.query: Who calls divide_line to find where lines should break?
questions.reference: Text.wrap in rich/text.py calls divide_line(str(line), width, fold=...) from rich/_wrap.py.

questions.query: What builds a Traceback from an uncaught or logged exception?
questions.reference: The excepthook installed by rich.traceback.install in rich/traceback.py and RichHandler.emit in rich/logging.py call Traceback.from_exception.

questions.query: What applies color downgrading when a style is turned into ANSI codes?
questions.reference: Style._make_ansi_codes in rich/style.py calls downgrade(color_system) on the foreground and background colors before getting their ANSI codes.

questions.query: Which console method creates the spinner used for status messages?
questions.reference: Console.status in rich/console.py creates and returns a Status renderable (rich/status.py) with a spinner.

questions.query: What measures the cells of a table column?
questions.reference: Table._measure_column in rich/table.py uses Measurement.get to find each cell's minimum and maximum width.

questions.query: What wraps plain Python objects so they are pretty-printed by console.print?
questions.reference: Console._collect_renderables in rich/console.py wraps objects that are neither strings nor renderables in Pretty(...).

questions.query: What draws a panel's border using the box characters?
questions.reference: Panel.__rich_console__ in rich/panel.py draws the border with the Box from rich/box.py: get_top, get_bottom and the mid_left/mid_right characters.

questions.query: Which progress column creates the ProgressBar renderable?
questions.reference: BarColumn.render in rich/progress.py returns a ProgressBar (rich/progress_bar.py) built from the task's total and completed values.

questions.query: What falls back to parsing a style definition when a name is not in the theme?
questions.reference: Console.get_style in rich/console.py looks the name up in the theme and otherwise calls Style.parse(name).

questions.query: What creates the Live display that a Progress renders into?
questions.reference: Progress.__init__ in rich/progress.py creates self.live = Live(...) with its refresh settings; Progress.start starts it.

questions.query: What runs the highlighter over text rendered from a plain string?
questions.reference: Console.render_str in rich/console.py applies the console's highlighter (ReprHighlighter by default) to the resulting Text when highlighting is enabled.
